notes.title: Raji: An Ancient Epic Roadmap: What's Planned For 2021!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The launch of our game sure has been an eventful occasion and we’ve learned a lot about the wishes of our community. Are you ready for a roadmap for 2021 that shows us what we’re working on and now we’re delivering on that promise?

Check it out below to see what's bound to happen over the next months

[/list]

[/list]

____

If you are a fan that has been holding out for a special sale before getting the game, your patience and preservation will now pay off as starting today and lasting until the 23rd of March, Raji: An Ancient Epic will be 50% off in the Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/730390/Raji_An_Ancient_Epic/

This is your chance to join Raji on her epic quest to save her brother Golu and defeat the demon lord, Mahabalasura!

notes.title: Raji: An Ancient Epic has Launched!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/50f0f79b1b0de6930d382ba9921b5c3718b17d94.jpg[/img]

Dear Raji Community,

It is with great joy that we are able to make this announcement - probably the single best announcement that we have been able to make. 

Our journey started in 2017 and though there were tough times, we ultimately made it to this point and we can now say:

[h2]RAJI: AN ANCIENT EPIC HAS OFFICIALLY LAUNCHED![/h2]

Thank you to everyone in our community, thank you to everyone who joined us in this journey, and finally, thank you to everyone for your amazing support!

[h3]Be sure to watch our special cinematic and trailer as well![/h3]

[previewyoutube=l94xywx7tfU;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=-KB9CVKxVfo;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, go and enjoy the game, we look forward to reading your feedback!

- Everyone who works on Raji!

notes.title: Now Supporting Hindi and Turkish Subtitles!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

Launch week is finally here, just 3 more days until our game goes live, so we hope that you are all just as excited as we are!

Of course, just because it is launch week, it doesn't mean that the work stops. For the most part, we've been mainly focusing on fixing the lingering bugs, however, we were able to find the time to do something special for the game, thanks to a huge show of support from our community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38838765/b03e243edb74859a775e956277434f5b11d221b9.jpg[/img]

So, we are pleased to announce that Raji: An Ancient Epic now has Hindi and Turkish subtitles! We pushed out the update to the Steam Game Festival demo and our prologue versions early on Saturday so you can activate the new subtitles right away!

We are especially happy to be able to launch the subtitles now as we have been working with the tightest timetables possible, so it was a fun-but-tough challenge for us to have it ready for the game's launch!

We would also like to thank everyone who contacted us requesting these languages, we always feel incredibly blessed to see that our community cares about the game this much.


[h3]Further News From Raji[/h3]
For people that are playing the Raji demo via the Steam Game Festival, we realized that the version was slightly outdated (behind the Prologue version) so we have updated it to bring the demo to version parity. This update brought in a few much-needed bugfixes and small balancing changes.

Finally, we'd like to remind you that we are running a special [url=https://gleam.io/PJdt5/raji-an-ancient-epic-giveaway]Raji giveaway contest[/url]. Enter today to have a chance to win a copy of the PC (Steam) version of Raji: An Ancient Epic! 

The event will run until 23:59 CEST on the 14th of October.
[list]
[*] Winners will be contacted during the morning (CEST) on the 15th of October so that they know that they have won before the game's launch.
[*] Prizes will be distributed in the form of Steam keys as soon as (humanly) possible after the game goes live!
[/list]

Thank you very much and we hope that you're enjoying our prolouge while you wait for the game's launch!

notes.title: Your Chance to Win a Copy of Raji: An Ancient Epic on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]Happy Saturday Raji Community![/h2]

We've got a special announcement for you. While we know that many of you here want to support us directly, (seriously, the comments that many of you have sent us about wanting to support us has been so nice), we still want to hold a special giveaway for our community to give you the chance to win a copy of our Steam version (full version).

So, this is your chance to win a copy of the PC (Steam) version of Raji: An Ancient Epic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/fc11269959d5bc9e2150e6b8c22347be157bf4ad.png[/img]

[h3]The Giveaway[/h3]
All you need to do is visit our [url=https://gleam.io/PJdt5/raji-an-ancient-epic-giveaway]giveaway page[/url] that we've set-up on Gleam and complete the tasks, doing so will put you in a raffle to win a copy of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/5e57107bb09a62f37d87c46c9e1bee53b27c1307.png[/img]

[h3]How Does the Giveaway Work?[/h3]
We've set up several tasks that you need to complete, however, you only need to complete the first one to be in the raffle.

The first task is to simply play the Raji: Prologue for a specified amount of time (don't worry, we've balanced it out so it's perfectly achievable).

Once you complete the main task, you'll unlock a few additional options that will grant you extra entries - increasing your chance to win!

This event will end on the 14th of October at 23:59 CEST and the winners will be announced on the 15th before the game launches, and the keys will be sent out once the game launches (naturally).

Once again, the link to the giveaway is here: https://gleam.io/PJdt5/raji-an-ancient-epic-giveaway

Good luck to you all!
